description: Machine-readable cross-layer financial workflow coverage map. Enumerates critical borrower, lender, remittance, settlement, and recovery journeys and the required contract, backend, frontend, and e2e test evidence paths. Consumed by scripts/check-financial-workflow-coverage.mjs to fail CI when changed financial paths lose required evidence.

journeys.title: Borrower submits a loan application
journeys.description: Borrower creates a loan application with requested principal, term, and purpose; server validates input constraints and persists an authoritative application record.
inputConstraints: principal must be a positive integer in minor units
termMonths must be within the product's allowed range
purpose must be a supported enum value
borrower must be authenticated and KYC-verified
journeys.authorization: Authenticated borrower acting on their own account; no cross-borrower access.
journeys.failureBehavior: Invalid or stale submissions are rejected with a typed error and no partial application record is persisted.

journeys.title: Borrower views repayment schedule and makes a repayment
journeys.description: Borrower retrieves the authoritative repayment schedule and submits a repayment; the payment is idempotent and applied exactly once in minor units.
inputConstraints: amount must be a positive integer in minor units
amount must not exceed remaining balance
idempotency key required on repayment submission
journeys.authorization: Authenticated borrower may only view and repay their own loans.
journeys.failureBehavior: Duplicate idempotency keys return the original result; insufficient or invalid amounts are rejected without mutating the balance.

journeys.title: Lender funds an approved loan
journeys.description: Lender commits funds to an approved loan application; commitment is recorded in minor units and reflected in lender portfolio and borrower loan state.
inputConstraints: commitment amount must be a positive integer in minor units
commitment must not exceed remaining funding requirement
lender must have sufficient available balance
journeys.authorization: Authenticated lender with an active funding account; cannot fund on behalf of another lender.
journeys.failureBehavior: Insufficient balance or stale application state rejects the commitment with no partial ledger entries.

journeys.title: Lender views portfolio and earnings report
journeys.description: Lender retrieves an aggregated portfolio view with outstanding principal, interest earned, and delinquency summary in minor units.
inputConstraints: date range must be valid and ordered
reporting currency must be supported
journeys.authorization: Authenticated lender may only access their own portfolio data.
journeys.failureBehavior: Invalid date ranges are rejected; dependency failures surface a typed error without returning partial aggregates.

journeys.title: Borrower initiates a cross-border remittance
journeys.description: Borrower initiates a remittance transfer with explicit source/destination currencies and amounts in minor units; transfer is idempotent and consent-gated.
inputConstraints: amount must be a positive integer in minor units
source and destination currencies must be supported
recipient must be a validated beneficiary
idempotency key required
journeys.authorization: Authenticated borrower with explicit consent captured for the transfer; beneficiary must belong to the borrower.
journeys.failureBehavior: Missing consent, unsupported currency, or duplicate idempotency key rejects the transfer without debiting the source account.

journeys.title: Borrower tracks remittance status
journeys.description: Borrower polls or subscribes to remittance status updates; status transitions are consistent across API, events, and UI.
inputConstraints: transfer id must reference an existing transfer owned by the borrower
journeys.authorization: Authenticated borrower may only view their own transfers.
journeys.failureBehavior: Unknown or foreign transfer ids return not-found without leaking existence.

journeys.title: Daily settlement batch reconciles lender and borrower ledgers
journeys.description: Settlement job aggregates the day's transactions and produces balanced ledger entries in minor units; reruns are idempotent per settlement date.
inputConstraints: settlement date must be a valid business day
batch must be idempotent per settlement date
journeys.failureBehavior: Imbalanced batches halt and alert without posting partial ledger entries; retries resume from last committed checkpoint.

journeys.title: Disbursement of settled funds to borrowers
journeys.description: Settled funds are disbursed to borrower accounts; disbursement is idempotent and reflected consistently in ledger, API, and UI.
inputConstraints: disbursement amount must equal settled amount in minor units
idempotency key required per disbursement
journeys.authorization: System/service account only; borrower sees read-only status.
journeys.failureBehavior: Failed disbursements are retried idempotently; partial disbursements are reversed before retry.

journeys.title: Delinquent loan escalation and recovery workflow
journeys.description: Overdue loans escalate through recovery stages; each stage transition is auditable and consistent across API, events, and UI.
inputConstraints: escalation requires days-past-due threshold met
stage transitions must be monotonic
journeys.authorization: Recovery operator role required for manual transitions; borrower sees read-only status.
journeys.failureBehavior: Out-of-order or stale transitions are rejected without mutating loan state.

journeys.title: Loan write-off and subsequent recovery
journeys.description: Unrecoverable loans are written off and later partial recoveries are recorded against the written-off balance in minor units.
inputConstraints: write-off requires approval and reason code
recovery amount must be a positive integer in minor units and not exceed written-off balance
journeys.authorization: Recovery operator with write-off approval permission; borrower sees read-only status.
journeys.failureBehavior: Recovery exceeding written-off balance is rejected; write-off without approval is rejected with no ledger mutation.
